scientific_depth.justification: The formulation is sound and grounded in real log-replay, but the introduction asserts 'Human crash statistics consistently implicate such occluded and sensor-limited situations' with no citation, an unsupported empirical leap. The POMDP tuple (S, A, P, r, gamma, Omega, O) is introduced in Section 3 but Omega and O are never used again; the observation design of Section 4.1 is never formally connected to the observation function. Capped at 60 (unsupported claims cap) until results arrive.

technical_execution.justification: Method details are unusually concrete (grid extents, weights, TTZ sentinel values, reward coefficients, replay-ratio scheduler). However the paper's central contribution -- occlusion-risk features -- is presented in Section 4.1 as an '(optional)' feature flag, which undercuts the framing of the entire paper. The Muon novelty claim ('to our knowledge its use in value-based RL for driving is novel') is a weak novelty assertion for a component that is orthogonal to the paper's thesis.

logical_flow.justification: Sections mostly flow well, but Figure 5 (learning curves, fig:curves) is never referenced from any prose; Figures 3 (fig:pareto) and 4 (fig:density) are only referenced from placeholder blocks, not from the running text. The introduction lacks a roadmap. The ablation table lists '+ occlusion features' while the main table lists 'Ours (no occlusion)', implying contradictory definitions of the full model. Capped at 60 (sections don't reference the figures they need).

writing_clarity.justification: Prose is generally precise, but 'genuine partial observability' is repeated verbatim three times (abstract, intro, conclusion), and the same rhetorical move ('precisely the states in which collisions occur' / 'exactly the regime of near-collision states') appears twice. The acronym VRU is used in Section 5 metrics and Table 1 without ever being introduced. The abstract at ~250 words enumerates every system component and buries the thesis.

evidence_presentation.justification: Placeholders are clearly delimited and every table/figure has a defined analysis plan, which is good discipline for a pre-results draft. But fig:curves is entirely unreferenced from the text, triggering the hard cap of 55. Table 1 and the ablation table disagree about whether occlusion features are part of the full model.

academic_style.justification: Tone is professional and consistent; no defensive language detected. The Limitations section is substantive rather than perfunctory. Terminology (TTZ, occupancy grid, barrier) is used consistently after introduction.

strengths: Sharp, well-motivated problem framing around occlusion and sensor limits, aligned with the observation and reward design.
Unusually concrete method section with exact coefficients, grid geometry, and system parameters drawn from the implementation.
The safety-efficiency Pareto analysis and stratified (density x occlusion) evaluation protocol are well designed and pre-registered before results.
Statistical protocol (multi-seed, bootstrap CIs, Welch/Mann-Whitney with Holm-Bonferroni) exceeds the field's norm.
weaknesses: Unsupported empirical claim about crash statistics in the introduction (no citation).
POMDP notation (Omega, O) introduced but never used; formulation and observation section are not formally connected.
Occlusion features -- the paper's headline contribution -- are described as '(optional)', contradicting the title and abstract framing.
fig:curves never referenced in prose; fig:pareto and fig:density not referenced from running text.
Ablation table row '+ occlusion features' contradicts main table row 'Ours (no occlusion)' about the definition of the full model.
VRU acronym used without introduction; 'genuine partial observability' repeated verbatim three times; abstract overlong.
questions: Is the full model defined with or without occlusion features? The two results tables disagree.
How is the observation function O of the POMDP formally related to the ray-cast visibility filter of Section 4.1?
Does the BC baseline see occlusion features too, so that the comparison isolates the learning signal?
note: Adapted pre-results review: axes involving empirical evidence are scored on the declared analysis plan, not on numbers, which do not yet exist. Weighted overall = 0.20*58 + 0.20*68 + 0.15*57 + 0.15*62 + 0.20*55 + 0.10*70 = 61.3.
